opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases; most grants below £300,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools or FE colleges, undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, local charities, or overseas organisations (except in exceptional cases with UK-focused dissemination plans).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (spring and autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities. Partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK.

opportunities.title: Strategic Fund

amount.raw: Up to £15 million available; major grants typically in the range of £1-3 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not individuals without formal employment/relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, or establishment of academic posts.
opportunities.summary: Research grants for original and ambitious projects that confront the scale and urgency of the UK's biggest social and economic challenges, responding to one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions. The next round is likely to open in the first half of 2027.
